title: SEC0: SSE frames without event field silently skipped
description:
watch.rs:345-371 only processes SSE frames where event_type.as_deref() == Some("state"). However, a malformed or keepalive frame with only a 'data:' line will have event_type=None and be silently ignored.

Per SSE spec, the event field is optional. A frame with data but no event should still be processed (defaults to event type 'message').

Current issue: If a server sends a keepalive data frame or a frame with no event: line, the state update will be dropped and the client will not fetch new messages.

Fix: Either:
1. Default event_type to 'message' when event field is absent (per SSE spec), OR
2. Process frames without an event field as 'state' updates (current intent), OR
3. Log a warning when a data frame has no event field, to catch misbehaving servers
